summary: Iteration 2 tested the 4 new features (stock guard, store settings, receipt store info, barcode scan, report export). Backend: 25/25 pytest tests passed including 4 new tests (TestSettings x3, TestStockGuard x2). Frontend: verified via Playwright - admin login OK, Settings page saves store info and shows in live receipt preview, POS barcode-input scans and adds product (Air Mineral via barcode 'QA12345' → cart, unknown code shows 'Produk tidak ditemukan' toast), checkout receipt renders store name/address/phone/footer, Reports CSV export triggers real file download (laporan-YYYY-MM-DD-YYYY-MM-DD.csv), Reports PDF opens new window without JS error, Products dialog has product-barcode-input, regression: POS + cart + checkout + navigation all work.

minor.issue: Endpoint requires auth (get_current_user); documentation says frontend Receipt component reads settings but useSettings hook uses authenticated api client - fine, but if ever exposed publicly it should be reviewed.
Payload only accepts SettingsInput with all fields defaulted; partial updates overwrite unspecified fields with defaults. Consider Optional fields for partial patch.
Loop validates one-by-one; if same product appears twice in items, individual qty check passes but cumulative may exceed stock. Consider aggregating by product_id first.

ui_bugs.issue: Still calls navigate() synchronously during render when user already logged in (React warning). Not fixed in this iteration.
Radix DialogContent missing DialogDescription/aria-describedby - a11y console warnings remain.

action_items: (Optional) Aggregate cart items by product_id in POST /api/sales stock validation to prevent bypass by duplicate rows.
(Optional) Support partial PATCH on /api/settings (currently PUT with SettingsInput full model overwrites all fields).
(Carry-over) Fix Login.js navigate-in-render warning and add DialogDescription to all Radix dialogs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py checkout(): validates stock per item but doesn't sum across duplicate product_ids in the cart - edge case.
server.py get_settings: exposed to any authenticated user - acceptable since store info is displayed on receipts.
Settings.js: preview receipt binds to form state directly, so unsaved edits show in preview - correct UX.
Reports.js exportCSV builds CSV client-side; UTF-8 BOM added correctly for Excel compatibility - good.
Reports.js exportPDF: uses window.open + window.print - browser popup blockers may block it, but it works when triggered from user click; verified new tab opens.

POS.js handleBarcode uses find() over products state loaded once at mount - after admin edits barcode in Products, POS must be revisited (route re-mount refetches). Consider a global refetch on focus if realtime needed.
useSettings hook: fires on every mount; consider a context to avoid repeated /settings fetches (POS/Receipt/Settings all call it independently).
Products.js form state: barcode field integrated correctly, persists via backend confirmed.
seed_data_creation: Set Air Mineral barcode to 'QA12345' during testing via API for barcode scan flow. Store settings updated to 'TEST Toko Kopi' / footer 'Terima kasih QA' - these persist in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 new features verified. Backend test file /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now has 25 tests (added TestSettings, TestStockGuard classes). Store settings currently set to 'TEST Toko Kopi' in DB; Air Mineral has barcode 'QA12345'. If retesting, note that these seeded values persist between sessions.
